jsonld_raw.name: COFFEE CREAM MOKA POT CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made of vegetable wax. Solid-color design shaped like a moka pot.

Coffee Cream | The fragrance opens with the deep intensity of coffee, evoking the damp, fertile scent of the soil where coffee plants are born, rich and dark in the shade. At the heart, vanilla adds a warm, enveloping softness, like the temperate air drifting through the plantations at dawn. The Peru balsam base leaves a resinous, amber trail that recalls the living earth, warm and deeply rooted.

Notes:
Top note: coffee
Heart note: vanilla
Base note: Peru balsam
